text.p: - Vladimir Semyonov, commander of Russian land forces, ostensibly relieved of his duties, plans to take his case to court.
- Russia intends to introduce a new simplified taxation system for small businesses.
- Parliament is to debate today a roster of draft tax laws aimed at increasing budget revenues.
- Protracted behind-the-curtain talks at the OSCE security conference in Lisbon made it possible for all participants to sign a joint political document.

- Russia and the United States take turns in facing troubles in space. Russians, fresh from a Mars probe disaster, perform a successful spacewalk while American astronauts fail to get out of space shuttle Columbia because of a technical hitch.
- Russia's judicial system could collapse instantly if the Federation Council does not approve today a constitutional law to back it up.
- Defence Minister Igor Rodionov has exceeded his authority when he relieved the commander of the land forces, Vladimir Semyonov, of his duties.
- Russia's striking coal miners could see their problems dwindle once commercial company Rosugol loses its right to distribute budget money.
- Interior Minister Anatoly Kulikov could soon be promoted to the post of a deputy prime minister in charge of Russia's military, police and security structures.
